why: Very close now - a yellow-striped post fills the far-left edge of frame (partially cropped, meaning we're near it), with a thinner yellow line mid-frame that may be the second post or a stand. Only one post is clearly resolved, and we're close enough that another large left turn like the proposed +22.1deg risks repeating the k1/k3 overshoot pattern (heading is already back near the +8-10deg bearing that worked at k2). Overriding: modest forward creep plus a lateral slide right (away from the close left post) and only a tiny yaw correction, to open the gap in frame without another big turn.
